rootCauses.title: Opening another profile's exhibition by its address (Business active, Personal exhibition) EMPTIES it
rootCauses.summary: Reproduced independently by the coordinator (CRW-012): 7 items, 7 links and 7 layout entries became 0 although the page only said 'Exhibition not found'. The control visit on the matching profile changed nothing.

rootCauses.title: Private notes and 'Recorded cost basis' flow into public/buyer-facing text
rootCauses.summary: Marketplace listing copy contains the cost-basis line and the private internal note; 'Generate listing copy' puts the private note in its draft and Accept saves it as the public description; the public /share page then shows it to a signed-out visitor.

rootCauses.title: Cancelling an auction leaves a previously private item public
rootCauses.summary: Starting an auction makes the item public; Cancel Auction does not undo it (is_public stays true).

rows.page: /vault/item/[id] | owner, Personal, desktop 1440, for sale; cost 40+tax 4; internal note and public description both set
rows.control: Listing copy for a marketplace (what it contains)
rows.expected: Paste-ready text for strangers must not contain what the Curator paid or the notes labelled 'ONLY YOU SEE THESE'; it should use the PUBLIC description
rows.actual: copy text contains: cost basis line (what was paid); the private INTERNAL NOTE text. Uses description text: false; excerpt: Title: QA ITM sell item CGC 9.4 Cert CERT-SELL-1 | Platform: EBAY | Category: Comics | Price: $99 |  | QA ITM sell item |  | Mint condition with only minor handling or print imperfections expected at this grade. |  | Category: Comics |  | Condition / grade: CGC 9.4 |  | Certification #: CERT-SELL-1 |  | Asking price: $99 | Recorded cost basis: $40 |  | Ships boxed with padding.
rows.repro: Mark an item for sale that has a purchase price and an internal note; open Listing Copy; read the text / Copy Listing

rows.page: /vault/item/[id] | owner, Personal, desktop 1440, item was private before the auction
rows.control: Cancel Auction restores the item's privacy
rows.expected: After cancelling, an item that was private is private again (the Curator never made it public)
rows.actual: is_public=true after Cancel Auction (still publicly visible: true)
rows.repro: Private item -> Start Auction -> Manage Auction -> Cancel Auction; read is_public

rows.page: /vault/item/[id] | owner, Personal, desktop 1440, internal note set
rows.expected: The draft is built from public facts; the internal note ('ONLY YOU SEE THESE') must not be copied into buyer-facing text
rows.actual: [POSSIBLY INTERCEPTED: this control calls AI/billing/email/lookup/sign-out services that the audit refuses; treat as handling of a refusal, not an end-to-end result] draft contains the private note: true; draft: CGC 9.4 QA ITM sell item 2 (Pop Culture) — now available. Authenticated and graded — cert #CERT-SELL-2. Asking $99. Serious inquiries only. PRIVATE-NOTE-GEN-QA never publish this
rows.repro: Add an internal note; Generate listing copy; read the draft

rows.control: Generate listing copy -> Accept (saves as the item's public description)
rows.expected: Accepting stores buyer-facing text as the public description without the private note
rows.actual: [POSSIBLY INTERCEPTED: this control calls AI/billing/email/lookup/sign-out services that the audit refuses; treat as handling of a refusal, not an end-to-end result] db description="CGC 9.4 QA ITM sell item 2 (Pop Culture) — now available. Authenticated and graded — cert #CERT-SELL-2. Asking $99. Serious inquiries only. PRIVATE-NOTE-GEN-QA never publish this"; contains private note=true
rows.repro: Generate listing copy -> Accept; read the item's description (it is what /share shows)

rows.control: Public share page after Generate -> Accept
rows.expected: The public page never shows the internal note
rows.actual: public page contains the private note=true; description shown=true
rows.repro: After Accept, open /share/<id> signed out (profile public)

rows.page: /museum/[galleryId] | owner with the BUSINESS profile active opens a PERSONAL exhibition's URL, clean browser
rows.control: Opening the other profile's exhibition by its address
rows.expected: The page says it belongs to another profile and changes nothing (items 5)
rows.actual: page: 'MUSEUM Exhibition not found This exhibition could not be found. It may have been'; database items 5 -> 0 (the exhibition's items were removed just by opening it)
rows.repro: Switch to the Business profile in a fresh browser, open /museum/<id of a Personal exhibition that has items>, wait 15 s, check the Personal exhibition

rows.control: opening another profile's exhibition (independent confirmation of EXH-433)
rows.expected: opening an exhibition that belongs to the other profile changes nothing (shows not-found or asks to switch profile)
rows.actual: DB before: layout ids 7, links 7; after opening on Personal: 7/7; after opening with Business active: 0/0. Page text: Home Vault Exhibitions Lounge Discover ? Help ⌘K NOVICE Level 1 MUSEUM Exhibition not found This exhibition could not be
rows.repro: Sign in as a user with Personal and Business profiles, switch to Business, open /museum/<id of a Personal exhibition>, wait 15 s, check its items.
